ruleDefinitions.name: Gpresult Display Group Policy Information
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects cases in which a user uses the built-in Windows utility gpresult to display the Resultant Set of Policy (RSoP) information

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\gpresult\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/z.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v.*")))
